name: india-stack-mcp
description: MCP servers for Indian accounting and tax: TallyPrime (ledgers, vouchers, day book, trial balance, purchase register), Zoho Books (contacts, invoices, payments with GST fields) and GST (GSTIN validation, e-invoice schema v1.1 JSON, GSTR-2B reconciliation). Writes are dry-run by default and destructive actions need human approval.
